// Volatility-Compression Release Model
// ATR/Range coil load + vol-of-vol rise + predictability.
// ATR: Wilder RMA via atr() — validated.

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLen = input(20, "Coil Length", 5, 100, 1)
volLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 100, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predict Length", 2, 200, 1)
loadThreshold = input(0.70, "Load Threshold", 0.0, 1.0, 0.05)
predictThreshold = input(0.60, "Predict Threshold", 0.0, 1.0, 0.05)
volRiseThreshold = input(0.05, "Vol-of-Vol Rise Threshold", 0.0, 1.0, 0.01)
rangeBreakMult = input(1.50, "Range Breakout Mult", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
atrBreakMult = input(1.05, "ATR Breakout Mult", 0.5, 5.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

range = high - low
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen) // Wilder RMA ATR

// Trailing windows excluding current bar
maxRange = highest(range[1], coilLen)
maxAtr = highest(atrVal[1], coilLen)
maxAtrVol = highest(atrVal[1], volLen)
minAtrVol = lowest(atrVal[1], volLen)

safeMaxRange = max(maxRange, 0.0001)
safeMaxAtr = max(maxAtr, 0.0001)
safeMaxAtrVol = max(maxAtrVol, 0.0001)

rangeComp = 1 - range / safeMaxRange
rangeComp = max(0, min(1, rangeComp))

atrComp = 1 - atrVal / safeMaxAtr
atrComp = max(0, min(1, atrComp))

coilLoad = 0.5 * rangeComp + 0.5 * atrComp
coilLoad = max(0, min(1, coilLoad))

// Vol-of-vol: normalized ATR dispersion over volLen (range of ATR vs its peak)
volOfVol = (maxAtrVol - minAtrVol) / safeMaxAtrVol
volOfVol = max(0, min(1, volOfVol))

volOfVolRise = (volOfVol - volOfVol[1]) >= volRiseThreshold

// Predictability: fraction of last predictLen bars where ATR and range moved in the same direction.
// Rolled from bar data so it cannot freeze at zero.
da = atrVal - atrVal[1]
dr = range - range[1]
sameDir = (da > 0 and dr > 0) or (da < 0 and dr < 0) or (da == 0 and dr == 0)
predictability = sma(sameDir, predictLen)

coilArmed = coilLoad[1] >= loadThreshold and volOfVolRise[1]
predictable = predictability[1] >= predictThreshold

release = range >= rangeBreakMult * maxRange and atrVal >= atrBreakMult * atrVal[1] and coilArmed
releaseEvent = release and not release[1]

buySig = releaseEvent and predictable and close > close[1]
sellSig = releaseEvent and predictable and close < close[1]
warnSig = releaseEvent and not predictable

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if warnSig { plotshape(bar_index, close, "Warning Release", "triangleup", "#ffaa22") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2)
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#ff9955", 2)
hline(loadThreshold, "#8899aa")
hline(predictThreshold, "#99aacc")

// 3D separate-pane scene: load as bars, predictability and vol-of-vol as scatter
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load 3D", "bars3d", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predictability, "Predictability 3D", "scatter", "#ff9955", "separate", 1)
plot3d(volOfVol, "Vol-of-Vol 3D", "scatter", "#b48cff", "separate", 2)

// 3D signal markers: loaded-and-predictable = green/red cones; loaded-but-unpredictable = orange diamond
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy 3D", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell 3D", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if warnSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Warning 3D", "diamond", "#ffaa22", markerSize, 1, "separate") }
